analysis: visualization only from strict saved results

human_scatter.axes: raw effect divided by SD across the same 50 pathways within each method; no centering
human_scatter.direction_quadrants: based on raw GSEA NES and Bridge-head delta signs
human_scatter.bridge_support: human biological-sample bootstrap 95% CI excludes zero
human_scatter.labels: five literature-relevant programs plus every opposite-direction pathway supported by either method

relative_heatmap.transformation: each method/condition column divided by its maximum absolute effect
